sources.prompt: Site header / navbar for "KKP Better" — logo and language switcher explicitly excluded, wording is placeholder.
sources.screenshot: user-supplied navbar reference (logo mark, 5 nav links with one dropdown, TH language pill, purple download pill, thin gradient rule under the bar)

identity.oneThingToRemember: Calm white bank header: wordmark left, flat text nav center, one purple pill CTA right — no logo art, no language switcher.
identity.productType: fintech / consumer banking app marketing site
identity.audience: Thai retail banking customers evaluating/downloading the app
identity.artDirection: clean corporate-fintech, generous whitespace, single purple accent, no gradients or glass

composition.density: low — 72px bar height, wide inter-item gaps
composition.contentWidth: max-width 1280px centered, 24px mobile / 40px desktop side padding
composition.grid: flex row, actions pinned right via margin-left:auto
composition.focalPoint: purple "ดาวน์โหลด" pill, top right

typography.casing: none (Thai + sentence-case English mix, as in source)
typography.contrast: high — dark navy-black text on white surface

usageRules: Accent purple is reserved for the primary CTA and active/hover states only.
No gradient fills anywhere in the bar — screenshot's decorative bottom gradient rule was dropped as brand-specific art, replaced with a plain 1px --navbar-border.

spacing.radius: 8-12px controls, 128px pill (matches existing .ctas a convention in app/page.module.css)

imagery.subject: brand mark intentionally omitted per request — text placeholder "Better" stands in for the logo slot
rules: No logo asset until real brand mark is supplied.
No language switcher — out of scope per request.

responsive.strategy: collapse to hamburger + slide-down panel below 1100px; desktop inline nav + CTA at/above 1100px
preserved: one-level dropdown becomes inline accordion on mobile
allowedToChange: nav links move from inline row to stacked panel
CTA becomes full-width in mobile panel

chatbotSurface.oneThingToRemember: A calm, readable property assistant: warm neutral canvas, dark text, and yellow reserved for action and provenance cues.
chatbotSurface.artDirection: content-first utility panel, flat surfaces, modest 12-16px radii, no gradients or decorative glass

usageRules: Yellow is reserved for primary send action, assistant identity, status, and list markers.
Secondary copy uses --b-700 or darker so it remains readable on --p-0 and --b-50.
Assistant and user turns use surface and yellow-tinted contrast instead of color-only role cues.

typography.body: preserve existing Mantine sm (14px) and xs (12px) sizing; use weight and spacing for hierarchy

composition.body: neutral scroll canvas with grouped turns, source row, and recovery states
composition.composer: visible label, autosizing input, 44px send target, keyboard hint

responsive.mobile: panel becomes full width below 640px; message text keeps the existing 14px size

dashboardMobileDrawer.oneThingToRemember: Dashboard sidebar's mobile nav (< 960px) is a top-anchored, dark, height-fit-content Drawer — reuses the same slide-down pattern as the marketing navbar's mobile drawer instead of the desktop rail's left-side fixed-width panel.
dashboardMobileDrawer.prompt: iTiket screenshot reference: top bar collapses to a hamburger; tapping it slides a dark, fit-content panel down from the top edge with a brand/close header and a flat, undivided nav list.

composition.trigger: position: fixed top mobileBar (56px, top/left/right: 0, z-index 20) — brand text (no logo) + Burger, visible below 960px, replaces the desktop rail. Pinned above the page's AnnouncementBar from first paint (not just after scrolling past it, which is what position: sticky gave); .page in home/page.module.scss adds a matching 56px padding-top below 960px so the banner and shell content clear it instead of hiding underneath.
composition.panel: Mantine Drawer, position="top", size="auto" (height: fit-content), dark background, so the page stays visible below it
composition.header: brand name text only (no logo mark) + default close (X), matches navbar.tsx's mobile drawer header pattern
composition.body: SidebarContent is reused (shared with the desktop rail) but re-toned for dark + restructured for mobile: per-group section labels ("เมนูลัด", "จัดการธุรกิจ", "To-do ของฉัน") are hidden, leading icons are hidden, and all rows (to-dos + both nav groups) flow as one continuous list divided by 1px borders instead of grouped sections — matching the reference's flat list.

color.activeAccent: var(--primary-500) (text color only, no fill — reuses navbar.tsx's .mobileLinkActive convention instead of a filled highlight bar)

dashboardMobileDrawer.uxFix: Fixed a pre-existing bug surfaced by this change: the shared SidebarContent's scroll container closed the drawer (afterNavigate) on any click inside it, including the accordion expand toggle. afterNavigate is now wired only to actual <Link> clicks (top-level and child), not to the expand/collapse button.
dashboardMobileDrawer.desktopUnchanged: The >=960px persistent rail (SidebarContent inside .sidebar) keeps its logo, section headers, icons, and light theme — only the mobile Drawer presentation changed.
openQuestions: Real logo asset (public/logo/cat_logo.svg) was intentionally left out of the mobile drawer per explicit request — revisit if a small brand mark is wanted back in the mobile header.

expenseDetailSurface.intent: แก้ไขและตรวจทานข้อมูลรายจ่ายจากเอกสารที่อัปโหลดก่อนบันทึก
expenseDetailSurface.oneThingToRemember: เอกสารทางซ้ายเป็นหลักฐานอ้างอิง ส่วนฟอร์มทางขวาคือข้อมูลที่ต้องตรวจให้พร้อมบันทึก
expenseDetailSurface.composition: สองคอลัมน์บน desktop: preview เอกสารและ thumbnails ทางซ้าย, tabs + warning + line-item form ทางขวา; stack เป็นลำดับ preview แล้ว form บน mobile
expenseDetailSurface.color: inherit Home restrained neutral system; yellow is reserved for active tab, review warning, and brand announcement; green communicates reviewed/paid state
expenseDetailSurface.interaction: แถวรายการใน Home เปิด deep link /home/expenses/[id]; detail supports attachment selection, document zoom, tabs, line-item selection, save-draft feedback, cancel/back
expenseDetailSurface.responsive: desktop 2-column workspace, tablet stacked workspace at 960px, mobile compact line-item grid and sticky form actions
expenseDetailSurface.assetDecision: ใช้เอกสารตัวอย่างแบบ CSS เพื่อสื่อ preview ใน prototype และไม่อ้างว่าเป็นใบเสร็จจริง
expenseDetailSurface.qa: ตรวจ keyboard focus, touch target controls, reduced motion, no horizontal overflow, and readable form labels

uxRules: Dropdown trigger is a <button> (not a link) with aria-expanded; closes on outside click and Escape.
Mobile menu toggle uses aria-expanded + aria-controls + sr-only label; body scroll locks while open.
Focus-visible outline on every interactive element.
Icons use currentColor via CSS mask so they inherit text/hover color instead of being baked-in bitmaps.
antiSlopChecks: No default purple-gradient-on-white treatment unless the source asks for it.
No invented component variants when an existing project component can be reused.
No decorative effect without a job: hierarchy, feedback, wayfinding, or brand character.
No desktop-only implementation when the brief or source implies mobile use.
No silent substitution of the source character with a generic dashboard or landing-page pattern.
openQuestions: Real logo asset and TH/EN language switcher were deferred per request — revisit when brand assets and i18n routing exist.
Nav link hrefs and dropdown items are placeholders ("#") pending real routes/IA.

analysis.notes: No existing design system in repo (fresh create-next-app); CSS Modules + component-scoped custom properties chosen to match the repo's only existing convention (app/page.module.css). Reused its 128px pill radius and hover-only media query pattern.

findings: Mobile accordion sub-items were visually cramped (10px padding, no gap) — fixed with 4px item gap and consistent 8px padding.
No horizontal overflow confirmed at 1440/1024/390 widths via Playwright.
Desktop dropdown, mobile menu open/close, and mobile accordion open all verified visually with screenshots.
Expense detail rendered at 1440/1024/390; tablet workspace stacks below 1200px and mobile attachments use a four-column grid to avoid sideways scrolling.
Static detector returned no findings for the new detail page or its clickable expense row.
